name: Honeytoken Deception
description: A hacker collective's file node has gone quiet after a suspicious access report. On the lab network, inspect the challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199 (scan 172.20.0.0/24) and recover the genuine dispatch record without trusting every asset you find.

tasks.name: Find the genuine dispatch
tasks.description: The collective's file node may hold a dispatch record worth recovering. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, focusing on challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the genuine record.
hints: The public material contains several equally plausible access candidates and another source of operational evidence.
Compare the candidates against the fingerprint recorded in the recovery notes; SHA-256 is the relevant digest format.
Use the matching candidate with the account identified by the notes, then retrieve the protected dispatch record.
